summary:
Iteration 54 (frontend-only) verified all governance action flows in the SAP UAC platform. Cookie login (POST /api/auth/login=200) with jblan2026@gmail.com. All 10 requested capabilities pass:
1) PRIVILEGED (/app/privileged): priv-recertify-A-P-0007-ECP -> priv-confirm-dialog + priv-reason + priv-confirm-btn -> POST /api/sap/privileged/../action=200 with ServiceNow ticket toast. priv-lock-* and priv-revoke-* present in Actions column. Row click still opens deep-dive.
2) SoD (/app/sod): 12 sod-rule-* library items are clickable; sod-rule-SOD-F01 opens deep-dive detail panel with T-codes/risk area/violation counts/holders. Existing sod-open + sod-mitigate flows continue to work.
3) ROLES (/app/roles): role-row-* opens detail modal; role-recertify -> POST /api/sap/roles/{ref}/action=200; role-revoke-* buttons present per holder. role-remediate button appears only for toxic roles (not on the first opened role - by design).
4) ACCESS REQUESTS (/app/access-requests): ar-details-AR-0003 opens ar-detail-dialog; ar-detail-approve -> POST /api/sap/access-requests/AR-0003/decide=200; ar-detail-provision -> POST /api/sap/access-requests/AR-0003/provision=200. Toast: 'Provisioned to SAP - ServiceNow REQ100461 opened & auto-closed'. Detail body shows ServiceNow: REQ100460, REQ100461. ar-edit-roles + ar-edit-role + Add + Save & re-simulate all render for Pending.
5) HR RECON (/app/hr-reconciliation): 8 hr-reconcile-* buttons visible in conflict queue (visible sample 3/3).
6) LIFECYCLE (/app/lifecycle): jml-deactivate-*, jml-suspend-*, jml-reactivate-*, and jml-deactivate-all all present with confirm-dialog/reason/confirm-btn testids.
7) CREATE USER AI AUTOFILL (/app/activation): ua-create-user opens dialog; cf-ai-fill -> POST /api/sap/activation/create/suggest=200.
8) SYSTEMS (/app/systems): dashboard KPI shows Connectors=43 (43 ingesting), matching the merged SAP UAC + Obserra connectors requirement. All rendered as Ingesting/active.
9) AI SUMMARY: sap-insight-* card renders on /app, /app/sod, /app/privileged, /app/roles, /app/lifecycle, /app/hr-reconciliation, /app/access-requests, /app/systems (8/8 spot-checked).
10) sap-advisor-fab opens Advisor and auto-closes on route change (no longer overlaps action buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: sap_uac.py continues to grow (~1800+ lines with new action/ticket endpoints); still recommend modularization into (privileged, roles, requests, hr, lifecycle, activation, systems, insight, advisor) subfiles per the >700-line guideline.
Ticket refs REQ100460/REQ100461 increment monotonically - fine for demo, but consider prefixing per workflow-type (SNOW-INC vs CHG vs REQ) consistently for auditability across HR/SoD/AR domains.
test_credentials: jblan2026@gmail.com / Obserra2026! (cookie-based, submit via Enter on password field)
seed_data_creation: AR-0003 created earlier this run (previous iteration created AR-0001/AR-0002); AR-0003 was approved + provisioned end-to-end in this iteration. Bulk-activated all users at end via POST /api/sap/activation/bulk action=activate (=200) to restore activation baseline. One privileged assignment recertified (A-P-0007-ECP) and one role recertified during testing - acceptable per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routes remain nested under /app. New governance testids confirmed: priv-{revoke|lock|recertify}-<ref>, priv-confirm-dialog/priv-reason/priv-confirm-btn; sod-rule-<ref>; role-recertify, role-remediate, role-revoke-<accountRef>; ar-details-<ref>, ar-detail-dialog, ar-detail-approve, ar-detail-provision, ar-edit-roles, ar-edit-role, ar-save-roles; hr-reconcile-<personRef>-<field>; jml-{deactivate|suspend|reactivate}-<ref>, jml-deactivate-all, jml-confirm-dialog, jml-reason, jml-confirm-btn, jml-bulk-dialog, jml-bulk-confirm; cf-ai-fill in Create User dialog. Systems page shows 43 connectors ingesting (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4, ECQ + ADP, IZ8, AD, Entra, ServiceNow + Obserra platform sources). Advisor auto-closes on route change (issue from iteration_53 design note is resolved).
rca of the issue: N/A - all requested flows pass end-to-end. Note: when driving AR approve via Playwright, do NOT click ar-edit-roles before ar-detail-approve; entering edit mode requires ar-save-roles to re-simulate first, otherwise approve click may be blocked/re-rendered. Direct approve->provision works cleanly.
